question: Should ClickClack adopt GitHub-linked project rooms, their public project/context API, and their persistent webhook-delivery model as supported core product surface?
rationale: The implementation is broad and proof-backed, but deciding whether these durable APIs, migrations, and GitHub integration semantics belong in the supported core cannot be resolved from patch correctness alone.

options.title: Sponsor core project rooms
options.body: Approve the durable project and webhook contract, then continue normal maintainer review toward merging this feature.

options.title: Request a narrower first slice
options.body: Keep the PR open but limit the initial supported surface, such as project storage and channel UI before broad webhook event coverage.

options.title: Defer the direction
options.body: Pause the PR until a maintainer confirms that GitHub project rooms fit the intended ClickClack product boundary.

recommendation.title: Sponsor core project rooms
recommendation.body: Approve the durable project and webhook contract, then continue normal maintainer review toward merging this feature.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the closest identifiable contributor in the supplied merged history for ClickClack chat and thread behavior, though the feature has no established owner yet.
